title: Master Page - Verify that user should be able to configured the multiple usage column.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
User should redirect to the master page
Column name should be added

steps.action: Select the column data type from the drop down
steps.expectedResult: Column data type should be selected
Record should be saved and validation message populate for the same
column name should be changed
updated name should removed and saved name should be visible
new row should be added in the grid
Column name should be added

steps.action: Select the column data type from the drop down
steps.expectedResult: Column data type should be selected
Record should be saved and validation message populate for the same
user should be redirect to the list page
